title: What If Gravity Took a Ten-Second Break?
description: An original fictional thought experiment about an ordinary morning becoming weightless. This is an animation development benchmark, not a scientific prediction of gravity switching off.

scenes.heading: AN ORDINARY MORNING
scenes.label: One tiny interruption.
scenes.narration: Your coffee leaves the table. The cup hangs in midair.

scenes.heading: GRAVITY TAKES A BREAK
scenes.label: Ten seconds. No warning.
scenes.narration: Imagine gravity taking a ten-second break. What would you reach for first?

scenes.heading: THE STREET FEELS DIFFERENT
scenes.label: Suddenly, every loose object matters.
scenes.narration: Outside, loose objects drift. A normal street becomes a room with no floor.

scenes.heading: A FICTIONAL RULE
scenes.label: A pause in gravity. Not in motion.
scenes.narration: For this story, motion continues. Only the familiar pull has disappeared.

scenes.heading: WHAT DO YOU HOLD ON TO?
scenes.label: Your coffee? Or your friend?
scenes.narration: Your coffee slips away. Your friend looks scared. Suddenly, the choice feels easy.

scenes.heading: THE MOMENT IT RETURNS
scenes.label: The ordinary becomes extraordinary.
scenes.narration: Then the countdown ends. You have never been happier to feel the ground.

scenes.heading: WHAT WOULD YOU GRAB?
scenes.label: Think fast. You have ten seconds.
scenes.narration: What would you grab first? And who would you make sure was beside you?
